title: Early UFO Accounts from Paraguay
description: In an article about UFO accounts in colonial Paraguay, I was drawn to some history I don't know much about. The early Franciscan missionaries participated and supported the encomienda system in which Spanish and Portuguese conquistadors ruled over the indigenous population demanding tribute and forced labor. When the Jesuit missionaries followed, they launched a new system of Christian socialism with the Guarani people called reductions . I will have to look further into that, but for now, we are interested in the archives the Jesuit missionaries left behind in Paraguay. These include a UFO sighting on August 10, 1631, in which a large, luminous orb moved slowly across a settlement, throwing off sparks behind it, before disappearing with a loud noise. The account wouldn't be so notable, except it was repeated in 1866, during the Paraguayan War, in an account that almost word-for-word the same. Both sightings were compared to a full moon, although what was observed didn't act like the moon at all. Read about these two Paraguayan UFO sightings, more than 100 years part, at Inexplicata. Disregard the "Chile" in the title. -via Strange Company (Unrelated image credit: maxime raynal)
